description: proto8/kernels 逐檔表（生成物，別手改）：tree 照資料夾巢狀，字串＝檔、物件＝夾，值＝那個檔檔頭的一句話；工具夾的 _entry／_tooldef.json／_metainfo.json 併成一格「名/」。要改說明去改檔頭，再跑 python3 wf/tools/index_gen.py --apply。誰連誰、誰 import 誰、bin/ 指令對哪個檔看 wf/knowledge/code-map/deps/。

base._chain.json: bundle aos/base: the usual base, outermost first: resource limits (cg), /run/user covered (mask), then the scripted fake brain (aos/llm/fake)
base.cg.json: 20% of one core, 512M memory (no swap), 64 processes/threads
base.mask.json: cover /run/user/<your uid> with an empty folder (no systemd --user, no D-Bus session bus)

aos.base-high.json: cgroup kernel, higher limits: 2 cores, 4G memory (no swap), 1024 processes/threads
aos.base-low.json: cgroup kernel, low limits: 20% of one core, 512M memory (no swap), 64 processes/threads

llm.fake.json: llm kernel, scripted fake brain (no model is called): model fake-model, 50 requests per run; a first message with 'four steps' gets read, write, edit…
llm.litellm-luna.json: llm kernel to the LiteLLM proxy on this machine (127.0.0.1:4000): only chatgpt-gpt-6-luna-nothink, 10 requests per run; put it outside any net kernel…

mask.run-user.json: mask kernel: cover /run/user/<your uid> with an empty folder (no systemd --user, no D-Bus session bus, no Wayland/PipeWire sockets)
mask.ssh.json: mask kernel: cover ~/.ssh with an empty folder (an example of masking one more path)

net.base-litellm-proxy.json: net kernel: only the LiteLLM proxy on the machine outside (127.0.0.1:4000, seen inside as 169.254.77.1:4000); 16mbit down, 8mbit up, 200 MB in all

uid.1.json: uid kernel: everything inside runs as uid 1 (outside: your first subordinate id); mini moves it to the innermost layer by itself
